name: Ingraham Glacier Direct
overview: Leave Camp Muir (10,080 ft) and reach the Ingraham Glacier by way of Cathedral Cap, or the shorter, steeper Cadever Gap, and rope up. Walk to Ingraham Flats at 11,100 ft, with the Disappointment Cleaver line in view to the east. The route goes straight up the 45 degree headwall, dodging crevasses of all sizes; the beaten track usually switchbacks, easing the pitch to roughly 35 to 40 degrees. Huge seracs hang toward the west near 12,500 ft, avoided by cutting east above the Cleaver. Crevasses near 13,000 ft are gigantic. Low-angle switchbacks lead to the summit rim at 14,100 ft, then 20 to 30 minutes' walk to Columbia Crest, 14,411 ft. Descend the same way.
